name: Mounting plate
purpose: Simple rectangular base with repeated through holes.
checks_to_try: Move the hole pattern closer to the edge and confirm a warning appears.
Increase hole diameter until holes overlap and confirm an error appears.
Confirm the drawing preview groups the holes as one repeated-hole callout.

name: Circular flange
purpose: Circular base with raised boss, center hole, and bolt circle.
checks_to_try: Confirm the bolt circle centerline appears in the drawing preview.
Confirm the grouped hole callout includes equal spacing and bolt-circle diameter.
Confirm Feature 3 can target Feature 1 top.

name: Boss block with side cut
purpose: Tests feature-face targeting and side-face projected drawing views.
checks_to_try: Confirm front and right drawing views show projected feature geometry.
Confirm through-cut depth does not cut both directions from the target face.
Confirm feature cards show warning badges if geometry is moved out of bounds.
